plan.hypothesis: Test mild horizontal flips and contrast changes with the strongest ten-epoch scheduled protocol.
plan.test_policy: Use original train for updates and original val for checkpoint selection; never load original test. No external sUAS data in training or selection.
plan.budget_note: Four local CPU threads, no concurrent training. Ten-epoch arms have a 1200-second cap; four-epoch continuation arms have a 600-second cap. Time checked between epochs; report actual completion.
plan.stopping_rule: At most 10 epochs, 4 non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs, or 1200 seconds checked between epochs.

scope_note: This tests applying each architectural change during layer4 adaptation while earlier parameters and BatchNorm statistics remain frozen. The shared head was fitted with the standard stem, which can initially disadvantage modified stems; this does not exhaust retraining with stem-specific head/BN adaptation.

error_review.selection_rule: Three lowest-F1 classes; up to two wrong predictions per class, smallest numeric image IDs; descriptive validation review only.
